crossRefs.note: Give ear, you heavens, and I will speak. Let the earth hear the words of my mouth.
For I will proclaim Yahweh’s name. Ascribe greatness to our God!
Now therefore be wise, you kings. Be instructed, you judges of the earth.
Hear this, all you peoples. Listen, all you inhabitants of the world,
both low and high, rich and poor together.
I will also speak of your statutes before kings, and will not be disappointed.
All the kings of the earth will give you thanks, Yahweh, for they have heard the words of your mouth.
Yes, they will sing of the ways of Yahweh, for Yahweh’s glory is great!
The rulers ceased in Israel. They ceased until I, Deborah, arose; Until I arose a mother in Israel.

parallels.note: Sing praises to God! Sing praises! Sing praises to our King! Sing praises!

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: “Hear, you kings! Give ear, you princes! I, even I, will sing to Yahweh. I will sing praise to Yahweh, the God of Israel.
translations.bsb: Listen, O kings! Give ear, O princes! I will sing to the LORD; I will sing praise to the LORD, the God of Israel.
translations.kjv: Hear, O ye kings; give ear, O ye princes; I, even I, will sing unto the LORD; I will sing praise to the LORD God of Israel.
translations.asv: Hear, O ye kings; give ear, O ye princes; I, even I, will sing unto Jehovah; I will sing praise to Jehovah, the God of Israel.
